parker-c.tagline: Compact solution for up to 4 vehicles
parker-c.description: Allows up to four vehicles to be parked at the same time, with independent access for each vehicle.
parker-c.longDescription:
The MODULO PARKER-C parking platform lets you park up to four vehicles simultaneously, with each vehicle entering and exiting independently of the others.

The solution doubles the available parking spaces without any structural extensions and is suitable for both private garages and larger investments.

Each unit has its own control panel, protected against unauthorised use by a special key or chips/tokens. In addition, every control panel is fitted with an emergency stop switch.
features: Independent access to every parking space
Sturdy supporting structure with hydraulic system
Separate control panels for each unit
Protection via key, chips or tokens
Emergency stop switch on every control panel
Doubles parking capacity without building work

variants.name: PARKER-C105
variants.description: Premium deck with an anti-slip surface

parker-s.description: System with inclined platforms for garages with limited ceiling height or restricted pit depth.
parker-s.longDescription:
The PARKER-S system is designed specifically for projects with limited ceiling height or restricted pit depth. The lower platform has a slight incline, allowing you to double the parking space in garages.

MODULO PARKER-S is dedicated to underground car parks and garages. However, it is primarily intended for investments where there are constraints on ceiling height or pit depth.
features: Inclined platforms for minimal pit depth
Doubles the number of parking spaces
Hydraulic system with the highest level of safety

parker-o.description: Standalone platform for private parking spaces. The structure disappears completely below ground.
parker-o.longDescription:
The MODULO PARKER-O100 is an independent parking platform designed specifically for private users. The structure runs entirely underground, allowing the surface to be finished seamlessly.

The platform can be integrated as part of a driveway or courtyard entrance. Perfect for two-car households that want to make the most of their available space.

stacker-p.description: Space-saving parking system for small businesses, hotels and apartment buildings. Requires a width of just 2.5m.
stacker-p.longDescription:
The MODULO STACKER-P10 is designed for facilities with modest parking needs, such as small commercial premises, small apartment buildings and hotels.

The system stands out for its user-friendly operation and straightforward installation. At a width of just 2.5 metres, it fits into a standard parking space. The platform fully encloses the lower parking space, protecting the parked vehicle.
features: Full protection for the lower vehicle

stacker-v.description: Innovative parking system for garages with limited ceiling height. The lightest of all MODULO parking platforms.
stacker-v.longDescription:
The MODULO STACKER-V10 is an innovative parking system for garages with limited ceiling height. The upper platform is angled and lowers itself to make optimal use of the available space.

It is the lightest of all MODULO parking platforms and combines flexibility, safety and maximum use of space. Ideal for apartment buildings and public facilities.

ls-system.description: Multi-level system with up to three levels. Optionally available with sliding gates and full automation.
ls-system.longDescription:
The MODULO LS is a system of independent parking platforms with up to three levels: underground (-1), ground level (0) and above ground (+1).

The system supports optional sliding-gate setups and full automation, eliminating the need to get out when calling a platform. Platforms on level 0 move horizontally, while platforms on levels -1 and +1 move vertically.
features: Independent parking spaces on every level

pallet.description: Automated parking system with movable pallets. Reliably prevents misparking and collisions.
pallet.longDescription:
The MODULO PALLET is an automated parking system based on automatic sliding pallets. Unlike other MODULO platforms, it enables fully automatic parking within a defined area rather than stacked parking.

The system reliably prevents incorrectly parked vehicles and collisions. It significantly reduces the manoeuvring area through predefined pallet routes and is ideal for sites with height restrictions.
features: Ideal where there are height restrictions
